description: European structural steel profiles. Dimensions and section properties per EN standards. Units: mm for dimensions, cm² for area, cm⁴ for second moments, cm³ for elastic section moduli, kg/m for mass per unit length.
note: Section properties are nominal values from European standards. For design use, verify against the current edition of the applicable standard. Version 2024.2 corrects the HEA series: heights h and flange thicknesses of HEA 900/1000 per the EN 10365 dimension tables, entry EN:HEA96 renamed to EN:HEA100, and Iy/Iz/Wel recomputed from the dimensions with scripts/i-section-properties.py (4 significant figures; agrees with published tables within 1 %). Version 2024.3 corrects UPE 80–400 (dimensions and section properties per the Stad UPE technical data sheet, EN 10279 sections) and RHS 100x60x4/5/6 (area and mass from the EN 10210-2 hot-finished corner radii). Checked with scripts/check-catalogs.py.
